before: Switching a list item between bullets and numbers minted a definition with default level indents, so the item moved.
after: The minted definition keeps each level's stated indent, suffix, alignment and level paragraph properties from the list the item leaves; an item its style numbers at another indent gets its own definition at that indent.
reason: The change writes ordinary numbering.xml definitions and paragraph indents through the existing package and tree op lanes. Released participants read and replicate them unchanged; no shared format or update meaning changes.
